items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I think she married a man named Smith

ctx.x: How much did the records sell for then?

I think about seventy-five cents...sixty-five or seventy-five cents, then they got up to eighty-five and up to a dollar, I think, and I was going to tell you about Mamie Smith. Her name was Mamie...it's been so long...but we travelled with her, I told you, with Bill Bailey's Troubadours. She was the singer--the main singer--with them. Then, her name was Mamie Smart. And then after that broke up, and she went to...to New York, and I think she married a man named Smith. And then she come out with that record--Mamie…
